description: This Java class defines an Android Fragment called ImageDetailFragment, which displays an image loaded asynchronously from a URL, with a progress indicator and click handling, used within an image browsing app.

classes.name: ImageDetailFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that displays an image loaded asynchronously with a progress indicator, handling click events and image loading lifecycle.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create a new instance of ImageDetailFragment with a specified image URL.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, retrieving the image URL from arguments.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout and initializes ImageView and ProgressBar references.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Sets up image loading via ImageFetcher and click handling if applicable.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cancels pending image work and clears the ImageView drawable.

methods.name: onImageLoaded
methods.description: Callback to hide the progress bar once the image has loaded.
